title: Remove unused tag entity from default CRM
description: Tags are not used in the Inmovel domain (user-confirmed removal; this ticket was added after the initial 'keep tags' answer was corrected). Remove all tag routes/components, the tag chips and tag filters on the contact (lead) list and show pages, TypeScript types, FakeRest data generators, and the tags table plus the contacts.tags column from the schema files. Depends on TASK-005 because both touch the contact types and FakeRest contact generator.
acceptance_criteria: All files under src/components/atomic-crm/tags/ are deleted
src/components/atomic-crm/root/CRM.tsx no longer imports or registers a 'tags' Resource
Contact (lead) list and show components render no tag chips, tag filters, or add-tag controls
src/components/atomic-crm/types.ts removes the Tag type and the tags field from the contact/lead type
src/components/atomic-crm/providers/fakerest/dataGenerator/tags.ts is deleted and its import removed from index.ts; the contacts generator no longer assigns tags
supabase/schemas/01_tables.sql removes the tags table definition and the tags column on contacts
supabase/schemas/03_views.sql removes tag references from contacts_summary if present
No TypeScript import referencing Tag or tags remains in CRM application files

non_functional_requirements.performance: No regression on lead list render
non_functional_requirements.security: No orphan RLS policies referencing the tags table
